title: Build a lifecycle impact ledger
description: Choose a service shape and expose the operational, hardware, data, and network terms behind one functional unit. The values are an illustrative planning model, not a universal benchmark.

profiles.label: Knowledge assistant
profiles.detail: A text service whose useful unit is one answer accepted by the user.

profiles.label: Vision inspection
profiles.detail: An image pipeline whose useful unit is one inspected item, not one model call.

profiles.label: Sensor triage
profiles.detail: A high-volume edge pipeline whose useful unit is one actionable alert.
